# @neural-ng/mcp-server

Read-only NeuralNg MCP server for component contracts and compact theme recipes.

RUN
npx -y @neural-ng/mcp-server

COMPONENT TOOLS

- search_components: search selectors, entry points, README and llms.txt text.
- get_component: resolve a schema-versioned structured Angular API contract.
- get_component_examples: return bounded published examples with language and heading.
- get_component_contract: legacy full-contract lookup for existing clients.
- recommend_components: deterministic component recommendations for a UI goal.

ICON TOOLS

- search_icons: search all 6,184 Neural Icons variants by name, category, or UI intent. Returns exact outline/filled classes, smallest CSS imports, markup and accessibility guidance. Brand icons are excluded unless include_brands=true.

COMPOSITION TOOLS

- plan_ui: convert a product goal into selected primitives, exact imports, providers, state, accessibility checks and implementation order. kind is auto, form, page or table.
- suggest_form_structure: create the same contract-backed plan with form structure fixed.
- suggest_page_structure: create the same contract-backed plan with page structure fixed.
- suggest_table_structure: create the same contract-backed plan with table structure fixed.

CORRECTNESS TOOLS

- validate_usage: parse templates with @angular/compiler and validate Angular syntax, control-flow descendants, custom elements, attribute directives, property/event/two-way bindings, required inputs, exported literal aliases, icon-only button labels, standalone imports, required providers and duplicate Toast channels. The schema-v2 result reports parser identity/version and NNG000 syntax failures. imports_json and providers_json are JSON string arrays.

PROJECT TOOLS

- inspect_neuralng_project: bounded read-only inspection of the MCP working directory for package versions, selectors, imports, providers, theme, Appearance, conventions and diagnostics. It accepts no path.
- suggest_consistent_ui: combine current-project inspection with plan_ui and distinguish reused conventions from newly introduced primitives.

THEME TOOLS

- create_theme_recipe: create a sparse recipe from high-level decisions.
- validate_theme_recipe: validate compact JSON against schema and token contract.
- edit_theme_recipe: apply safe dotted set/unset changes and revalidate.
- diff_theme_recipes: return only changed compact recipe paths.
- get_component_theme_contract: read one component's supported theme properties.
- compile_theme_recipe: return summary, diagnostics and artifact sizes, not full CSS.

RESOURCES

- neural://catalog
- neural://package/exports
- neural://icons/catalog
- neural://themes/catalog
- neural://themes/schema
- neural://themes/presets
- neural://themes/presets/neutral
- neural://themes/presets/glass
- neural://themes/presets/mist
- neural://themes/presets/futuristic
- neural://themes/ai-guide
- neural://components/{id}/contract
- neural://components/{id}/readme
- neural://components/{id}/llms

THEME RULES

- Choose neutral, glass, mist, or futuristic as the compact recipe base.
- Work on the compact recipe; do not emit or request all 1,348 resolved tokens.
- Read only the target component theme contract before adding component overrides.
- Prefer detail=names. Request defaults only when values are required.
- Validate every created or edited recipe.
- Use diff_theme_recipes instead of repeating unchanged recipe fields.
- Use `npx neural-theme build` to write CSS, tokens, reports and type artifacts.

GENERAL RULES

- Treat MCP results as read-only package documentation and deterministic tooling.
- Start non-trivial screens with plan_ui, then fetch standard contracts and only the examples named by exampleQueries.
- Run validate_usage before presenting generated NeuralNg template code; resolve every error diagnostic and review warnings.
- Use search_icons instead of inventing nt-* classes. Preserve the returned import and require an accessible label on icon-only controls.
- For an existing workspace, inspect it before planning; use suggest_consistent_ui when consistency matters more than a greenfield recommendation.
- Use get_component detail=summary for discovery and detail=standard before implementation.
- Request detail=full only when class slot definitions or all embedded examples are required.
- Import components from the exact entryPoint returned by the contract.
- Use returned selectors and model names; do not invent aliases.
- The server does not edit projects, execute shell commands, install packages,
  access the network or read arbitrary filesystem paths.

THEME QUALITY AND MIGRATION

- Prefer presets with quality=release unless the user explicitly requests preview styling.
- Neutral is release quality; Glass, Mist, and Futuristic are experimental preview presets.
- Theme validation rejects declaration injection, external CSS URLs and malformed aliases.
- MCP does not rewrite legacy recipes. Use neural-theme migrate or migrateThemeRecipe() first.
